one_liner: Senior project/portfolio manager overseeing production schedules, resources, contractors, and metrics for DoD acquisition training courses at Fort Belvoir.
fit_summary: This GS-15-equivalent role requires eight years of portfolio or project management, a PMP and expert integrated-master-schedule skills. Daniel's resume has a Lean Six Sigma Yellow Belt but no PMP or scheduling tools, and his only supervision was a five-person intake center in 2019, so skip it.
eligibility: Open to the public (excepted service, Title 10 §1746); no federal status needed.
Required: PMP certification from PMI or an equivalent project management certification.
Band C requires a bachelor's degree in an appropriate discipline plus at least eight years of experience in the functional area; submit transcripts if education is used to qualify.
Specialized experience must cover multi-project portfolio management, IMS/critical path scheduling, resource forecasting, KPI dashboards, and supervising personnel and contractors.
Security clearance listed as 'Other', so the investigation requirement is unclear.
